format.events: Keyed by event id. 'name' matches the event name in sailor-events/events.json.
format.kind: arena | unique | pve | trade | siege | reset | seasonal
format.rewards: Groups of reward entries. Arena groups: win, draw, defeat, kill. Other groups are named after their source (e.g. roc, deathbone). Paths read like events.unique-clash.rewards.defeat.
format.rewardEntry: item (id in 'items'), count (default 1), chance (0..1, omitted = guaranteed), max (cap per event), delivery (drop | inventory, default drop), note.
format.rewardNotes: Free text about the rewards that has no item.
format.requirements: itemPoints (minimum), maxItemPoints, level {min, max}, job (any | trader | hunter | thief), jobSuit, guild, register (NPC), noSpeedBuffs, notes.
format.items: Item id -> name and kind. kind: currency | equipment | material | consumable | booster | scroll | box | avatar | other.

flowers.name: Evil Scented, Illusion, Life, Energy and Whirling Snow Flowers

roc.name: Roc
roc.summary: Weekly boss in Roc Mountain: defeat Roc, then its stronger form Deathbone.
description: Roc is a weekly unique boss event located in Roc Mountain.
Defeat Roc and its stronger form, Deathbone, for valuable drops.

notes: Move to Gate of Ruler in Roc Mountain and buy a key to enter its lair.
Gate of Ruler is only open for a short time.

medusa.name: Medusa
medusa.summary: Periodic unique boss with rare Egyptian equipment and alchemy materials.
description: Medusa is a unique boss that spawns periodically. Defeat her for rare Egyptian equipment and alchemy materials.

notes: Enter the Gate of Sarin Tribe and defeat all her guardians to spawn Medusa.
Gate of Sarin Tribe is only open for a short time.

moon-gem.name: Moon Gem
moon-gem.summary: Get Moon Pots from Event So-Ok and trade 1 pot + 10 Moon Gems for a reward.
description: Every hour Event So-Ok gives out Moon Pots for 10 minutes (xx:50 to xx:00), 1 to 10 at random.
Collect Moon Gems by killing monsters: 1 pot + 10 Moon Gems = 1 reward. Moon Gems also work as Vigor Potions.

notes: Speak to Event So-Ok in any town during the event to get Moon Pots.

clash-of-the-gods.name: Clash of the Gods
clash-of-the-gods.summary: Team PvP around three Egyptian God uniques and waves of Mummies.
description: Three Egyptian God uniques (Anput, Satis and Wadjet) and Mummy elites. A God kill gives 100 points to the player and their team, a Mummy 2 points, an enemy player 1 point.
When the first Anput spawns, 40 Mummies spawn in each team's zone. At 10, 5 and 2 minutes left, 40 Mummies spawn in the losing team's zone.

poison-temple.name: Poison Temple
poison-temple.summary: Job-only area where three uniques spawn at once.
description: Three uniques spawn at the same time, one on each circular platform: North West, South West and South East.
Enter through the Tunnel of Abyss teleporters; entry is only open while the uniques spawn.

sailors-clash.name: Sailors Clash
sailors-clash.summary: Team PvP arena with loot boxes during the match.
description: A team-based PvP arena event. Loot boxes spawn at 09:30 (right at the start), 06:20 and 03:10.

unique-clash.name: Unique Clash
unique-clash.summary: Team PvP arena with unique monsters.
description: A team-based PvP arena event with unique monsters.

styria-clash.name: Styria Clash
styria-clash.summary: Job-themed team PvP arena with loot boxes during the match.
description: A job-themed team-based PvP arena event. Loot boxes spawn at 09:30 (right at the start), 06:20 and 03:10.

carnage-arena.name: Carnage Arena
carnage-arena.summary: Free-for-all PvP arena with a bonus for each kill.
description: A free-for-all PvP arena event. Earn bonus rewards for each kill.

carnage-party.name: Carnage Party
carnage-party.summary: Team PvP with random teams of 2 CH and 2 EU players.
description: A team-based PvP arena event. Players are put into random teams, no party needed.
Each team has 2 CH and 2 EU players.

ghost-hunt.name: Ghost Hunt
ghost-hunt.summary: Co-op hunt for ghost monsters with Talismans of Exorcism.
description: A cooperative PvE event where players hunt ghost monsters with Talismans of Exorcism, sold at the Grocery Shop.
Cancel all movement speed buffs before the event starts, or you can't take part.

ba-random.name: BA Random
description: Battle Arena with random team assignment.

notes: No Item Point requirement: matchmaking uses Item Points.

ba-party.name: BA Party
ba-party.summary: Battle Arena with your own party.
description: Battle Arena where you enter with your own party.

notes: No Item Point requirement: matchmaking uses Item Points.

ba-guild.name: BA Guild
description: Battle Arena where you enter with your guild.

notes: The Guild Master or a deputy registers the members.

ba-flag.name: BA Flag
description: Battle Arena capture-the-flag mode.

notes: No Item Point requirement: matchmaking uses Item Points.

ba-job.name: BA Job
description: Battle Arena job-themed mode.

notes: No Item Point requirement: matchmaking uses Item Points.

sa-solo.name: SA Solo
sa-solo.summary: Solo Survival Arena; rewards for up to 40 games a season.
description: Solo Survival Arena. Each season grants rewards for up to 40 games; the limit carries over to the next season.

sa-party.name: SA Party
sa-party.summary: Party Survival Arena; rewards for up to 40 games a season.
description: Party Survival Arena. Each season grants rewards for up to 40 games; the limit carries over to the next season.

anubis-isis.name: Anubis & Isis
anubis-isis.summary: Job Temple unique bosses; entrance at Salt Post in Alexandria.
description: A job temple unique boss encounter.
The Job Temple entrance is at Salt Post in Alexandria.

selket-neith.name: Selket & Neith
selket-neith.summary: Job Temple unique bosses; entrance at Salt Post in Alexandria.
description: A job temple unique boss encounter.
The Job Temple entrance is at Salt Post in Alexandria.

haroeris-seth.name: Haroeris & Seth
haroeris-seth.summary: Job Temple: three shadow uniques of rising difficulty.
description: A job temple encounter with three shadow uniques of increasing difficulty.
The Job Temple entrance is at Salt Post in Alexandria.

fortress-war.name: Fortress War
fortress-war.summary: Weekly guild siege; hold a fortress to earn its towns' tax.
description: Weekly guild-vs-guild siege. Conquer a fortress to earn tax income from its towns. Lasts 60 minutes.
Registration stays open until 19:30 GMT+2. Fortresses: Jangan, and Bandit (max. 2350 Item Points).

notes: Pick Pet and Fellow Pet must both be dismissed to teleport into the fortress areas.
Bandit Fortress: 2350 Item Points at most.

capture-the-flag.name: Capture the Flag
description: A capture-the-flag PvP event only for characters between level 60 and 120.
Trade 10 Ice Trophies for one random reward at Event So-Ok.

special-trade-1h.name: Special Trade (1 hour)
special-trade-1h.summary: All special trade routes are open for an hour.
description: Special Trades are time-limited events where all special trade routes are enabled. See the jobbing guide on Sailor's website.
Daily: 02:00-03:00 GMT+2 (1 hour), 15:00-16:00 (1 hour, 2 hours on Sunday), 20:00-22:00 (2 hours, not on Sunday).

special-trade-2h.name: Special Trade (2 hours)
special-trade-2h.summary: All special trade routes are open for two hours.
description: Special Trades are time-limited events where all special trade routes are enabled. See the jobbing guide on Sailor's website.
Daily: 02:00-03:00 GMT+2 (1 hour), 15:00-16:00 (1 hour, 2 hours on Sunday), 20:00-22:00 (2 hours, not on Sunday).

fence-trade.name: Fence Trade
fence-trade.summary: Special Trade for thieves, usually an hour after Special Trade.
description: Fence Trades are Special Trades for thieves. They usually start one hour after Special Trades. See the jobbing guide on Sailor's website.
Thu, Fri, Sat and Sun: 03:00-04:00 and 16:00-17:00 GMT+2.

calendar-reset.name: Calendar Reset
calendar-reset.summary: The attendance calendar can be claimed again.
description: The Attendance Reward Calendar resets and can be claimed again.
Once the calendar ends, its rewards can no longer be claimed.

genie-reset.name: Genie Reset
description: Genie Reset resets the Genie Quest and the Genie Quest Manager, a daily quest that helps you gear up.
You may have to abandon the quest if you outlevel it.
rewardNotes: Lv 71-90: D11 Egy A and Egy B equipment.
Lv 91-100: D11 Egy A, Egy B and D12 Magic equipment.
Lv 101-110: D11 Egy A, Egy B and D12 Magic, Rare and Legend equipment.
Lv 111-130: D12/D13 Magic, Rare and Legend equipment.

balloon-carnival.name: Balloon Carnival
balloon-carnival.summary: Collect Rubber Pieces from monsters and trade them with Jooa.
description: Carnival Manager Jooa collects Rubber Pieces, which monsters of every kind drop all over the world.
Defeat monsters, collect Rubber Pieces and trade them with Jooa for rewards.
rewardNotes: See the event page for the full list.
All rewards except Avatar and Pet expire when the event ends (May 31st).

notes: Speak to Jooa in any town during the event to get Balloons.
